description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling regional endpoint configurations for Amazon S3. It includes methods for creating configuration providers based on environment variables, configuration files, and fallback defaults, as well as mechanisms for caching and unwrapping configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to generate and manage AWS S3 regional endpoint configurations, including environment-based, ini file-based, fallback, and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that retrieves the regional endpoint setting from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from a specified ini file and profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
